crossRefs.note: So the king sent Jehudi to get the scroll; and he took it out of the room of Elishama the scribe. Jehudi read it in the…

people.name: Baruch
people.line: Jeremiah's scribe who recorded and delivered his prophecies.

translations.web: They said to him, “Sit down now, and read it in our hearing.” So Baruch read it in their hearing.
translations.bsb: “Please sit down,” they said, “and read it in our hearing.” So Baruch read it in their hearing.
translations.kjv: And they said unto him, Sit down now, and read it in our ears. So Baruch read it in their ears.
translations.asv: And they said unto him, Sit down now, and read it in our ears. So Baruch read it in their ears.
